title: elleanthus aureus

This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and improve respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Elleanthus aureus include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
